summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Mining and Analysis Training Course. Learn essential techniques to extract insights from data and drive informed decisions.
lede: Data mining and analysis help professionals turn structured business data into documented findings and recommendations. Designed for analysts and others who use or commission analysis, this course develops a disciplined workflow from defining a question and assessing data quality to preparing datasets with SQL and pandas. You will practise exploratory analysis, build and evaluate predictive models with scikit-learn, and communicate results, limitations, and risks through reports or dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who use, manage, or commission data mining and analysis in operational decision-making. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who can work with spreadsheets or structured business data and want a disciplined route into SQL, Python-based analysis, and applied predictive methods.
modules: Data Mining Reporting and Deployment Planning
prerequisites: You need basic spreadsheet and data-handling experience, but no prior coding background. TrainingCred can provide practice datasets, SQL examples, Jupyter Notebook exercises, and course templates. Python, pandas, scikit-learn, Tableau, and Power BI activities depend on the agreed delivery setup. Participants should bring laptops if the programme includes hands-on labs. No commercial software purchase is required for the core exercises when open-source Python tools are used, while Tableau or Power BI activities may use an existing organizational licence or instructor-provided demonstration environment.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
